task_definition.task_name: Instrument Response Retrieve via IRIS Web Services

task_description.overview: Fetch instrument response data in RESP or SAC poles & zeros format using ObsPy Iris client or FDSN station metadata.
steps: Decide whether to use FDSN StationXML or IRIS-specific service for response data.
If using FDSN, request StationXML for target station/channel/time.
If using Iris client, call traveltime(), distaz(), or flinnengdahl() if needed for travel-time modeling.
Extract and save instrument response in RESP or SAC PZ format.
Integrate response information with waveform data for deconvolution.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Retrieve instrument response for network={network}, station={station}, location={location}, channel={channel} between {starttime} and {endtime}. Figure the response.
